about: The largest size in bytes of each release binary of `just build-release` (stripped, with the ghostty screen backend). `just bench-size` fails when a binary is larger. The budgets of 2026-11-18 were the sizes of 3ef1f834 (0.0.12 and the libghostty-vt fixes: efrd 43199992, efr 14949848, efr-sbx 3560776) plus 2 percent. cargo bloat found no crate twice that matters and no feature on by accident in efr: the growth since the budgets of v0.0.4 is efr's own code of 0.0.5 to 0.0.12. It found one fault in efrd: `just build-release` built the three binaries in one cargo run, so the regex features of efr's syntax colours (fancy-regex) joined the regex of efrd, which cost efrd 1146752 bytes (42053240 bytes alone at 3ef1f834). On 2026-11-19 each budget grew once by the measured growth of 0.0.13 (at 041e4e28, in one cargo run: efrd 44653944, +1453952; efr 15194264, +244416; efr-sbx 3561648, +872). efrd added efr-media with the image crate (PNG and JPEG) and miniz_oxide (0.62 MB in the probe build), the attachments (the uploads, the intake, the blob dir and its cache), the Expo push client and the push service; efr added the @path words, the uploads, the row of a prompt with attachments and efr push test. Then `just build-release` got a cargo run of its own for efrd, and the efrd budget went down by those 1146752 bytes. At 74a60ccf (with efr clip and the repairs of 0.0.13) the sizes are efrd 43607544, efr 15207784 and efr-sbx 3561688. 0.0.13 has no small pictures of attached images. Lower a budget when a change makes its binary smaller.
